notes.title: Turkish update!
notes.content:
The Turkish localization update for Arima Lodge is now live! You can now fully experience the game in Turkish. Special thanks to the Turkish localization team (Ichineko Loc. - Zeynep Nazlı Kolkıran, Işık Çağlar, and Nisa Selin Yağız) for their contributions. Enjoy the game!
